intro: The Dominican Republic has the Caribbean's highest mountain and its lowest point.

chapters.title: Land
text: Pico Duarte, 3,098 m, is the highest peak in the Caribbean. Lake Enriquillo, below sea level, is the lowest point and has American crocodiles. Beaches like Punta Cana line the coasts.

chapters.title: Whales
text: Thousands of humpback whales gather in Samaná Bay each winter.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of the Dominican Republic's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
